name: Shogun of the Prophet's Guard (Temple of Mur)
desc:
The Shogun of the Prophet's Guard at the [Temple of Mur](location:temple_of_mur), formerly known as the Shogun Captain, is an instanced boss near the [Deep Thresher Nest](location:deep_thresher_nest) encountered through its location by a boundary. This boss is optional to challenge [Zi'eer, the Fourth Prophet](entity:the_lord_regent), however each Memento has certain Talents and Mantras that can only be obtained by defeating this boss. It also goes without say that defeating the Temple Shogun is necessary to obtain a completion mark on the associated Memento tag in the character creation menu.

**Starting Fight with Shogun**

1.  Recommended but not mandatory: Reach Power 5.
2.  Make your way to the [Deep Thresher Nest](location:deep_thresher_nest), below the trenches close to where the Deep Widow is and instead of going towards the Widow, go the other direction and enter the Boundary.
3.  Upon loading into the instanced area, walk up to the standing Shogun and he will start fighting you.

His attire consists of a Blackleaf Helm that is combined with a Royal Guard's Kabuto, an Etrean Siege Cuirass combined with an Iron Cestus, and Etrean Siege Sabatons.
additional_info: -   The variant encountered in the Temple of Mur was originally named "Shogun Captain", a nonsensical, contradictory title. A _shogun_, short for _sei-i taishogun_ meaning "Commander-in-Chief of the Expeditionary Force Against the Barbarians", was the chief military ruler of Japan for a portion of its history. There are no other ranks within the position of _shogun_, and as such, a "Shogun Captain" is akin to a "Secretary of Defense Captain", "General Captain" or "President Captain". This is likely why it was renamed to match the other Shoguns of the Prophet's Guard, following complaints of racism, as those enemies represent a more accurate use of the title.
